The following-driver preparedness rule is covered, but the universal legal classification and any statutory crossing or load exceptions require exact current official authority before being taught as universal.

VERIFY: ID-PILOT-LOAD-DIMENSIONS — Physical page one hundred six says some load dimensions require pilot vehicles but gives no thresholds. No numerical permit or pilot requirement is invented.
